title: Lovely River View - Walk Downtown, Garage, Balcony
description:
WALK to downtown Nashville while staying at this stunning high-end condo in the EVE building. Comes w/ 1 FREE parking spot in a gated garage. Enjoy your morning coffee on our private balcony overlooking Cumberland River. Located in a very secure building. Washer/Dryer, dining table, high-end appliances, neon sign + more. Walking distance to downtown Nashville Broadway bars, restaurants & Germantown. Near Brooklyn Bowl, Sounds Baseball Stadium, Ryman, Titans stadium, Country Music Hall of Fame.

The space
THE HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 2 Bedrooms + 3 Beds 
★ Walk to Downtown Nashville & Broadway Bars
★ Smart HD TV in the living room
★ Located on one level - no stairs to climb
★ Private Balcony with outdoor furniture overlooking Cumberland River
★ Dining table with seating for 4
★ High-speed WiFi
★ 1 Free parking spot in gated garage
★ Washer/Dryer in the condo 
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Big windows with natural light
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Located next to the Germantown neighborhood - a popular area with great restaurants, coffee shops and shopping
★ Right next to Sound Baseball Stadium & Brooklyn Bowl (see some great music concerts!)
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Plenty of closet storage space for your clothes & other items
★ Central AC + Heat
★ Secure building with key code entry
★ Elevator in the building
★ Neon signs
★ View of Cumberland River
★ Full length mirrors

The space is the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. High-quality mattresses + bedding, tasteful elements incorporated throughout, modern amenities and plenty of space. This condo will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville. You can’t beat this location - walking distance to so many things!

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: Queen Bed 
Bedroom 2: Full over Full Bunk Bed
Living Room: Air Mattress available upon request

BATHROOM
Bathroom: Full size with shower/tub combo,  in the hallway 

Walk To (alphabetical order):
- Ascend Amphitheater
- Bicentennial Park
- Bridgestone Arena (Predators)
- Brooklyn Bowl Music Venue
- Country Music Hall of Fame
- Country Music Television (CMT)
- Farmers Market
- Germantown
- Hard Rock
- Honky Tonks
- Music City Center (Convention Center)
- Printer’s Alley
- Restaurants such as Jonathan’s, Merchants, Jeff Ruby’s, Puckett's, Morton's, The Southern Steak & Oyster, Wildhorse Saloon and numerous others!
- Ryman Auditorium
- Schermerhorn Symphony
- Sounds Minor League Baseball Stadium
- Tennessee Performing Arts Center (TPAC)
- Titans Stadium

Guest access
You'll have the whole condo to yourself. We are here to help with any of your needs!

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.

Please note that this is a city condo and Nashville is growing quickly! There may be some construction noise around the area. Also, there is an active train line next door that does make noise when passing. It's fun to watch and we do provide sound machines for light sleepers.
